tasks.final_text: The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics. It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.

I am nervous because I recently tried to submit my math problem set; unfortunately, the mathematics department at Stanford University are bastards and they did not accept it. To be perfectly frank, my soul is crushed and I would be tempted to visit Home Depot were I not awaiting the beginning of the upcoming Formula One season. I must stay strong for Oscar Piastri.
